non_issues.claim: The concurrent reader/writer test checks only that rows are whole and never asserts that a partial line was actually seen, so it passes even when the race never happens.
non_issues.why_not: The stress block in section 6 only says it checks that a reader racing a writer never raises and sees only whole records, and it does assert that. Whether a torn line actually becomes visible depends on thread timing, so asserting that one was observed would make the test flaky. The torn-line handling the reviewer wants exercised is already tested deterministically: section 1 writes unterminated and cut-multibyte tail lines and asserts they are skipped, and section 5 covers a log holding only a torn line. The missing assertion therefore leaves the behaviour covered and is not a defect.
non_issues.source: pooled cluster p2, ruled invalid, accepted as a non-issue by lead on 2026-10-23
